TP.GSYIH20.BY.B1GQ is the headline GDP aggregate; the other seven series in the group are expenditure components (household/government consumption, GFCF, stocks, exports, imports) and are deliberately not mapped.

series.definition: Gross Domestic Product at purchaser's prices, expenditure approach, current prices. Source unit is thousand TRY; scale 1000 converts to base TRY units so macro amounts match the base-currency convention used for company fundamentals. Current prices means nominal, NOT inflation-adjusted.
